[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provides tips on choosing the right shrimp, recommending fresh, high-quality shrimp, medium to large size (16-20 count per pound), and mentions popular types like Gulf shrimp, Pacific white shrimp, and Argentine red shrimp.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant gives preparation tips for shrimp, including rinsing, drying, removing shells and tails, deveining, and thawing if frozen.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant shares cooking tips for the shrimp, emphasizing the importance of using a hot skillet, not overcrowding, avoiding overcooking, and adding acidity with lemon juice.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] The assistant provides a basic Lemon Garlic Shrimp recipe with the following ingredients:  
- 1 pound large shrimp, peeled and deveined  
- 2 cloves garlic, minced  
- 2 tablespoons unsalted butter  
- 2 tablespoons freshly squeezed lemon juice  
- 1 teaspoon Dijon mustard  
- Salt and pepper to taste  
- Fresh parsley or thyme for garnish (optional)
